scripts.check-errors: npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx && npm run build
scripts.deploy:build: echo '🔨 Building application...' && vinxi build --no-minify && echo '✅ Build complete in .output'
scripts.deploy:activate: if [ -f .output/server/index.mjs ]; then echo '🔄 Activating new build...' && rm -rf production-old && mv production production-old 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r .output production && echo '✅ New build activated' && echo '📦 Old build saved in production-old for rollback'; else echo '❌ Build invalid (.output/server/index.mjs missing)'; exit 1; fi
scripts.rollback: if [ -d production-old ] && [ -f production-old/server/index.mjs ]; then echo '⏪ Rolling back...' && rm -rf production && mv production-old production && echo '✅ Rollback successful'; else echo '❌ No backup found for rollback'; exit 1; fi
scripts.deploy:cleanup: echo '🧹 Cleaning up...' && rm -rf production-old && echo '✅ Cleanup complete'
scripts.kill:3001: echo '🔪 Killing process on port 3001...' && (fuser -k 3001/tcp 2>/dev/null || true) && echo '✅ Port 3001 freed'
scripts.postinstall: npx playwright install-deps && npx playwright install
scripts.s: git pull && npm i --force && npm run build && npm run start
scripts.send-test-email: dotenv -e .env -- tsx scripts/sendTestEmail.ts admin admin@decodeui.io kapilpipaliya@gmail.com
scripts.pm2:start: git pull && npm i --force && npm run build && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs
scripts.pm2:reload: echo '🔄 Reloading PM2...' && pm2 reload ecosystem.config.cjs && echo '✅ PM2 reload complete'
scripts.setup: git pull && npm i --force && npm run build && npm run pm2:start
scripts.deploy: echo '🚀 Starting deployment...' && git pull && npm i --force && npm run deploy:build && npm run deploy:activate && npm run pm2:reload && echo '✅ Deployment complete! Run "npm run deploy:cleanup" to remove old build.'
scripts.deploy:rollback: echo '⏪ Starting rollback...' && npm run rollback && npm run pm2:reload && echo '✅ Rollback complete!'
